notes: Release notes are 100% boilerplate across the whole collected window, so no dated feature claims came from them. Excluded as beta/limited: Clubs (gym weekly leaderboards + activity feed) is 'currently in beta at select gym locations' and only for new signups (help 38657483026967). Included but flagged rolling-out: Exercise Percentile Ranking ('rolling out gradually and may not be available to all users yet') and Live Heart Rate ('Now gradually rolling out on Android and iOS'; iOS needs iOS 26 + Apple Watch or AirPods Pro 3). Platform-limited claims kept with the limit in the detail: On-demand workouts, Timed Intervals, Normalize Weights, Primers, Start-of-week (iOS only); Bluetooth HR monitors and Wear OS (Android only); Fitbit (iOS only). Not claimed as a feature: 'Import a workout from a photo or screenshot' exists on Android only (help 38318585683991) - omitted from claims as non-iOS; add if the master list is cross-platform. Google Play also mentions a Wear OS Tile (Android). No iPad support: help 'We don't currently support iPad' (38144798013719); App Store compatibility lists iPhone, Apple Watch, Mac (M1+), Apple Vision only. Web (app.fitbod.me) is account/billing/onboarding only ('Web for on-boarding purposes only' - FAQ). Exercise library size is inconsistent across sources: App Store 1000+, help 1,500+ and 1,600+ (Fitbod for Business article and 'How Fitbod Creates Your Workout'). Garmin: only the website FAQ quick-stats/llms.txt list Garmin under 'Wearable Sync'; help centre documents Garmin only as a BLE heart-rate broadcaster on Android - treat as weak. Excluded as pricing/B2B: Family/Duo plans, Fitbod for Business (admin dashboard, company challenges), HSA/FSA via Flex, gift codes, lifetime membership, subscription pause. Weekly set targets: help notes targets cannot be edited and workouts do not guarantee hitting them. Custom exercises cannot be edited after creation and are not auto-recommended. Apple Watch app is a companion: workouts must be started, edited (swap/add exercises) and saved on iPhone; Always On display not supported.
